seoTitle: Corona-Norco USD Calendar 2025-2026 | CNUSD Track Dates & PDFs
seoDescription: Corona-Norco USD Calendar 2025-2026 with elementary and secondary track calendar PDFs, holidays, breaks, minimum days, early dismissal notes, and key CNUSD planning dates.
calendarNotes: Corona-Norco USD publishes separate 2025-2026 elementary and secondary track calendars. The earliest elementary A-D track instructional dates begin in July 2025, while Traditional elementary and secondary tracks begin in August 2025. Families should use the matching PDF for their student's track because minimum days, early dismissal days, conference days, late starts, and track-change dates vary by school level and track.

calendarFaqs.q: When does the CNUSD 2025-2026 school year start?
calendarFaqs.a: CNUSD start dates vary by track. The elementary A-D track calendar begins in July 2025, while Traditional elementary and secondary calendars begin in August 2025. Families should verify the exact start date in the PDF that matches the student's school and track.

calendarFaqs.q: Why are there two CNUSD PDFs for 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The complete CNUSD 2025-2026 calendar is split between an Elementary School Track Calendar and a Secondary School Track Calendar. Both PDFs are needed for a full district-level reference.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CNUSD Thanksgiving Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The CNUSD track calendars mark Thanksgiving Holiday during the week of November 24-28, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CNUSD Winter Break in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The CNUSD track calendars mark Winter Break beginning December 22, 2025. Return dates vary by track and school level, so families should verify the matching PDF.

calendarFaqs.q: Does CNUSD have minimum days and early dismissal days?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The elementary and secondary track calendars mark early dismissal, minimum days, conference days, inservice days, teacher prep days, and late starts where applicable.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the Corona-Norco USD calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the Corona-Norco USD ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

customSections.label: CNUSD Calendar Overview 2025-2026
customSections.content: The Corona-Norco USD 2025-2026 calendar is split into two official PDFs: the Elementary School Track Calendar and the Secondary School Track Calendar. Elementary students may follow A, B, C, D, or Traditional tracks. Secondary students may follow Intermediate, High School, or JFK Middle College schedules. This page combines the two source files into a planning reference, but families should always confirm dates against the PDF for their student's campus and track.

customSections.label: CNUSD 2025-2026 Calendar PDF Sources
customSections.content: A complete CNUSD 2025-2026 calendar review requires both official PDFs. Use the elementary PDF for A, B, C, D, and Traditional elementary tracks. Use the secondary PDF for Intermediate, High School, and JFK Middle College schedules.

customSections.label: CNUSD Track Calendar Guide 2025-2026
customSections.content: CNUSD uses track labels instead of one districtwide calendar grid. Elementary A, B, C, and D tracks apply to Eastvale, Harada, Parks, Reagan, and Rondo. The elementary Traditional track applies to listed campuses such as Academy of Innovation, Adams, Anthony, Barton, Chavez Academy, Corona Ranch, Coronita, Eisenhower, Foothill, Franklin, Garretson, Highland, Home Gardens Academy, Jefferson, Lincoln Fundamental, McKinley, Norco, Orange, Parkridge, Prado View, Riverview, Sierra Vista, Stallings, Temescal Valley, Todd, Vandermolen, Vicentia, Victress Bower, Washington, and Wilson. Secondary tracks include Intermediate, High School, and JFK Middle College schedules.

customSections.label: How We Verify CNUSD Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official CNUSD school calendars and bell schedules page, the elementary track calendar PDF, and the secondary track calendar PDF. Dates are checked separately for elementary A, B, C, D, and Traditional tracks, plus secondary Intermediate, High School, and JFK Middle College schedules.

The official CNUSD calendars remain the source of record for revisions, school-specific schedules, emergency closures, bell schedules, and same-day announcements.
